def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # === input validation ===
    for name, arr in [
        ("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
        ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
        ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call),
    ]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be 2-dimensional")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if not (arr <= 0).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")

    if not (
        logp_with_result.shape
        == logp_call_only.shape
        == logp_no_call.shape
    ):
        raise ValueError("shapes of input matrices must match")

    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isscalar(tau_filter) or np.isnan(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative scalar")

    # === compute keep mask and margins ===
    sum_with = logp_with_result.sum(axis=1)          # shape (n,)
    sum_call = logp_call_only.sum(axis=1)            # shape (n,)
    sum_no   = logp_no_call.sum(axis=1)              # shape (n,)

    baseline = np.maximum(sum_call, sum_no)           # better baseline per candidate
    margin = sum_with - baseline                      # improvement over better baseline

    keep = margin > tau_filter
    margins = margin.astype(np.float64)

    return keep, margins
